sn45.153:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave kumbho nikkujjo vamateva udakaṃ no paccāvamati || evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto vamateva pāpake akusale dhamme no paccāvamati || || Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu a- a- maggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto vamateva pāpake akusale dhamme no paccāvamati || || Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti viveka- || la || sammāsamādhim bhaveti viveva- virāga- nirodhanisitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu a- amaggam bhāvento a- a- maggam bahulīkaronto vamateva pāpake akusale dhamme no paccāvamatī ti || ||
